request.description: The latest match run. Staff also see `ineligible` products and each product's screening and rule results. Only products of active lenders with an agreement in force, in the application's category, are considered. Each result names the lender (`id`, `key`, `name`, `organizationId`); partners pass `organizationId` as the lender scope when the borrower confirms sharing by SMS code (`POST /partner/applications/:id/borrower-consent/verify`). Borrower, partner and staff contexts.

response.name: 200 OK
